name: clear-glass-lite
description: A decoupled, standalone fork of Clear Glass's provider-login shell — no NEXUS wiring, no orchestrator/cortex/guardian dependency, no SISO bus. Real per-provider multi-account session isolation, real userscript injection, a lightweight local capture/query API (guardian-lite), and a customizable CLI — small enough to drop into any Electron project.
author: James Brooks (Erosmancer)
